correctness.rationale: A(y) returns to the first quarter exactly for y in [3/4,1); outside that return region the remaining dyadic branches are only translations +1/2 and -1/4. Therefore tracking rational affine half-open subintervals yields a finite exhaustive first-return tree, with no surviving paths after time 10. Independently recomputed all five full partitions and rational moments. For s=4, the five explicit intervals map via translations +3/10,+3/10,-9/20,+3/10,-9/20 and cycle with total measure 1/2; the six-level return tower plus a fixed subbase has measure 1/2 and covers the complement.
residual_risks: The statement in the source assumptions that A and F_s are bijections on [0,1) is not literally correct at exceptional endpoint 0; the standard dyadic odometer is a measure-preserving a.e. bijection and the F_s image misses one point. Pointwise first-return partition on B and the stated island were checked separately and remain valid. This wording must be corrected before publishing the full source.
